title.vi: Lệnh Dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe (Quảng cáo — Miễn trừ) 2021
title.th: คำสั่งบริการสุขภาพ (การโฆษณา — การยกเว้น) 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Healthcare Services (Advertisement — Exemption) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 3 January 2022.

4.—(1) The Advertisement Regulations do not apply to a directory relating to one or more licensees, that satisfies the requirements in sub‑paragraph (2).
(2) The requirements mentioned in sub‑paragraph (1) are the following:
(a)the listing relating to a licensee in a directory must contain only contact information about the licensee;
(b)the directory must list all licensees —
(i)by name in alphabetical order; or
(ii)in numerical or other sequential order;
(c)the directory must not give greater prominence to the listing relating to any licensee relative to the listing relating to any other licensee.
(3) In this paragraph, “directory” includes —
(a)a list of the occupants of a building; or
(b)a list of licensees published in any form or medium,
whether or not the list also includes any person who is not a licensee.
